title: Is your whisky really whisky?
sub: The answer is on the back label.

caption:
Is your whisky really whisky? 🥃 India drinks more whisky than any country on earth, yet a lot of it isn’t made from grain.

In 2004, about 90% of what India sold as “whisky” was made from molasses, the leftover from sugar making that rum is made from. In Europe, whisky must be made from grain, so very little Indian “whisky” can be sold as whisky there. Meanwhile, Indian single malts are winning world awards.

Large Sahab’s tip: read the back label. Look for “malt”, “grain” or “single malt”.

Check your bottle and tell us below what it says 👇 Save this and share it with your whisky group.

Drink slow. Never drink and drive. 18+
